scope: stock Harbor Oracle reference entry only; separate from author calibration and model trials
public_path: original source solve -> actual fixed /work output -> mechanical harness-public evas_write/evas_submit -> last FrozenCandidate -> FrozenCandidateVerifier private current cases
mount_boundary: two actual bind destinations /logs/agent and /logs/artifacts; no private final package mount. Oracle alone receives solution upload. Network isolation is not claimed.
evidence_boundary: archive/receipt SHAs identify retained private actual evidence; no public download is promised. Local calibration archives are not fresh NativeTrials.
source_test_sh_boundary: source tests/test.sh not executed verbatim; portable wrapper invokes identical source verify.py/checker with CANDIDATE/VERIFY_OUTPUT
